Admiral Hotel is looking for a Souschef who is ready to step forward as a leader and front figure in the kitchen. You value classical craftsmanship, thrive on creating structure, and enjoy taking responsibility—not only for the food but also for the team behind it. As Souschef at aye aye, you’ll be the driving force in the daily kitchen operations, setting the standard for quality, precision, and teamwork.

aye aye – part of Admiral Hotel

aye aye is Admiral Hotel’s restaurant – a modern interpretation of classic gastronomy with a focus on flavor, precision, and craftsmanship. We combine the intense flavors of the Mediterranean with Nordic simplicity, working with pure ingredients that are transformed into simple yet delicious dishes.

Meet the team behind aye aye here: https://restaurantayeaye.dk/team

Who you are

As our new Souschef, you will become a key part of a well-established kitchen management team. You will report directly to the Head Chef and have significant influence on our menus, work structures, and the daily working environment.

You will work across the entire culinary operation – from our restaurant aye aye and the terrace to room service and large banquets.

You’ll be a great fit if you:

• 
Are a trained chef with at least 5 years of experience in a similar role.

• 
Are structured and quick to act in situations that require immediate solutions. In other words—you can plan, stay organized, and ensure the kitchen is always ready for service.

• 
Have strong communication skills, ensuring handovers, orders, and teamwork are always clear and precise.

• 
Understand and agree that a good working environment is the foundation for great food.

• 
Take professional pride in your work—you care about quality, craftsmanship, and attention to detail in every dish.

• 
Master classical techniques and are confident with sauces, stocks, pasta, fish and meat butchery, bread baking, as well as ice cream and dessert preparation.

What we offer

• 
Full-time position with a fixed schedule (normally with every other weekend off)

• 
Fair working conditions under a collective agreement.

• 
A team of food enthusiasts who love their craft.

• 
A workplace with a strong sense of community. There’s room for laughter and plenty of opportunities to be social with colleagues through our many staff events.

• 
Great employee discounts and 4 annual stays at Strawberry hotels across the Nordics.

Do you see a match?

If this sounds like something for you, don't hesitate to send us an application.

Admiral is situated in the heart of Copenhagen, where the sea meets the city, and where Copenhagen meets the world. Housed in a historic 18th-century warehouse along the scenic harbor, Admiral blends modern elegance with rich history creating authentic warmth. At Admiral, we strive for ambitious excellence in everything we do – from the smallest details to the most memorable guest experiences and with a culture rooted in attentive hospitality, we create a sense of home, where every interaction is infused with genuine care and a passion for service.

Admiral is more than a place to stay in Copenhagen. It’s a place to be.

TIPSTER is looking for a Partnerships & Events Manager to shape, secure, and deliver the drops, pop-ups, and events we bring to hundreds of thousands of community members. Working closely with our leadership and operations team, you’ll build lasting relationships with hospitality partners, negotiate collaborations, and take an active role in bringing them to life.

TIPSTER is on a mission to change how people discover food and drink. Our drops are curated, limited-time offers that connect our community with exceptional food-and-beverage concepts. Alongside collaborations with names such as Gasoline Grill, Ceres, and Atelier September, we create events and pop-ups around the world, including our BAKERY RUN series.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in hospitality and sales who is as comfortable closing a sale as they are helping run an event. You’ll have a direct influence on who we work with and what our community gets to experience, with your focus shifting between sales and events throughout the year.

YOU WILL

• Identify and approach restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and other hospitality concepts for drops.

• Develop and pitch drop concepts, negotiate terms, and secure agreements with partners.

• Build and maintain long-term partner relationships, developing opportunities for repeat collaborations.

• Help develop new event and pop-up concepts and research potential venues and partners.

• Coordinate with venues, partners, and suppliers to keep plans, timelines, and practical details on track.

• Take part in the hands-on execution of events and pop-ups, from preparation and setup to on-site operations and follow-up.

All work will take place at our office in Frederiksberg.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experienced in sales, with 2-4 years of relevant professional experience and a background in the restaurant or food-and-beverage industry (e.g., you have a wine sales rep background or similar).

• Outgoing and confident in approaching new partners, with a strong instinct for building lasting relationships.

• Genuinely interested in restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and the people behind them.

• Commercially minded and comfortable pitching ideas, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage several collaborations at different stages.

• Proactive and dependable, taking ownership of tasks and following them through to completion.

• Comfortable balancing relationship building and sales with practical, hands-on event work.

• Adaptable when priorities shift and eager to develop your skills in partnerships and events.

WHAT TIPSTER OFFERS

• A direct role in shaping how our community discovers great places around the world through drops, events, and pop-ups.

• A place on a team challenging how people discover and experience food and drink.

• Responsibility and opportunities to grow from day one.

• The opportunity to build long-term relationships with some of the world’s best restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and food-and-beverage concepts.

• A varied working day that combines commercial responsibility, creative development, and hands-on execution.

• An informal, collaborative workplace with a small, globally active team.

HOW TO APPLY

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Emma Trøst, Head of Operations, at emma@tipster.io or Julie Schacht, Event & Operations Manager, at julie@tipster.io.

If TIPSTER’s mission aligns with your ambitions, send your cover letter, CV, and any relevant supporting documents to career@tipster.io.

Are you up for a challenge?

We are looking for a senior project manager with commercial understanding and technical flair. Ideally with experience from international projects touching upon both civil works and production systems (Mech/Elec/Aut) as we participate in both greenfield and brownfield projects around the world.

The Company

Frontmatec is recognized for developing and delivering high-quality systems across the entire meat industry value chain - ranging from carcass classification, slaughtering lines, and cutting and deboning lines, to hygiene solutions, control systems, logistics, and packaging. Frontmatec's value propositions center on providing equipment that enhances competitiveness by increasing yield, improving raw material utilization, raising hygiene standards, and reducing dependence on labor resources. As a result, the company's customers typically are high-volume slaughterhouses, where optimization leads to significant efficiency gains.

In 2022, Frontmatec Group was acquired by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. (in the following referred to as KKR), a leading American investment firm with a portfolio of over 700 companies worldwide. Following the acquisition, KKR established Fortifi, a dedicated FoodTech division focused on acquiring and developing companies within the industry. Fortifi brings together innovative businesses to drive technological advancements and operational excellence across the food sector. Within Fortifi, Frontmatec is the largest player, contributing significantly to the group's expertise and market presence. There is a total of 3,000+ employees across Fortifi. Frontmatec serves as the key driver of innovation and growth within this expanding portfolio.

Your Future Role

The role of a Senior Project Manager is to lead complex and business-critical customer projects, ensure successful delivery, and contribute to the continuous development of project execution, customer relationships, and organizational capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities

· Lead and manage complex or high-impact customer projects end-to-end

· Ensure delivery on time, within budget, and in line with quality standards

· Act as primary point of contact and build strong customer relationships

· Lead cross-functional project teams and ensure high performance

· Drive planning, scheduling, and financial tracking with transparency

· Proactively manage risks, opportunities, and margin development

· Coordinate execution phases including implementation and delivery

· Act as escalation point for stakeholders

· Ensure alignment between commercial, technical, and operational aspects

· Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement

Accountabilities

· Overall responsibility for project performance and customer satisfaction

· Leadership of cross-functional teams and delivery excellence

· Financial performance including budget control and forecasting

· Application of project governance and best practices

· Team performance and collaboration

· Improvement of execution efficiency

About you

To be successful in this role you need to have:

- Good stakeholder management skills

- Financial and technical understanding

- Fluency in minimum Danish and English languages

- Ability to travel internationally (30-45 days / year)

- Experience with larger projects +10 mil USD

- Persistence and an eye to critical details

Ideally you also have:

- One or more project management certifications

- Experience from the food industry/ meat industry

- Experience working in AX 2012

What is in it for you

We welcome you to a messy environment where we are currently streamlining and cleaning up. The salary is only decent given the occasional hectic environment and ad hoc challenges that can occur in our projects. However, the team is great and the company is full of good and helpful colleagues. Furthermore, you will have a stake in our company as you will become an owner cf. Fortify's Ownership Programme.

Company Description

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for your next challenge? At Deloitte Engineering, we are seeking motivated part-time student helpers who want to take an active role in improving their technical and problem-solving competencies while growing our Engineering practice.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software engineer and enable a smooth transition to a potential full-time position after your studies. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a student worker at the Engineering offering, you will be supporting experienced developers on many different projects. To thrive in our team, you embrace working with varying tech-stacks and different aspects of development. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

• Enabling DevOps through development of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You are a Master's student at the top of your class, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, or similar with at least one year of studies left and the energy to work 15-20 hours per week with us. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

• Programming-wise, you have experience with either Java, C#/.Net, Python, C, C++, GO, Clojure or JavaScript/TypeScript.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

• You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.

• You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

• Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.

• Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.

• The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Do you want to work on some of the most complex bridge, immersed tunnels and underground structures in Denmark and internationally? Are you motivated by structural engineering, advanced analysis and developing innovative solutions? Do you want to be a part of an international frontrunner in major structures? Then this could be your next opportunity at COWI.

At COWI, we are seeking a Junior Structural Engineer to support our team on major infrastructure projects. You will join a highly skilled group of engineers delivering solutions for bridges, immersed tunnels, underground structures and other complex civil engineering projects. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will contribute to projects that improve how people and societies connect.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Junior Structural Engineer, you will contribute to the design and analysis of complex infrastructure projects from early concept development through detailed design and construction support. You will work closely with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, gaining practical experience and developing your technical skills and engineering judgement.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Performing structural analysis and design of civil engineering structures

• Working with FEM and structural analysis tools

• Preparing calculations, technical documentation and design deliverables

• Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, BIM and other engineering disciplines

• Contributing to digital engineering initiatives, including automated workflows and parametric design solutions

• Participating in technical discussions, reviews and knowledge-sharing activities within the team and structural engineering community

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

We are looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and is eager to develop within a collaborative and international environment. You combine a strong interest in structural engineering with curiosity about new technologies, digital tools, and innovative ways of solving engineering problems. Knowledge of design of bridges, tunnels, underground structures or other complex concrete structures will be highly relevant.

On top of that you have:

• A Master degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline

• 0-5 years of professional experience in structural or civil engineering.

• Knowledge with finite element modelling (FEM) and structural analysis

• Knowledge of concrete design principles and relevant design standards such as for instance Eurocode 2

• Interest or experience in automated workflows and parametric design tools, such as Grasshopper

• Interest or experience in AI, programming or engineering automation is an advantage

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to organise own work while contributing actively to a team

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Shruti Gupta at srgu@cowi.com, or Head of Discipline Major Structures, Konrad Bienko, at kobi@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Why join COWI?

• Work on complex Bridge, Tunnel and Underground structures that push the boundaries of engineering, technology and sustainability.

• Get the opportunity to contribute to major international projects with global impact.

• Access international Master Classes and learning opportunities to support your professional development.

• Join a strong international network of 30+ countries, sharing knowledge and expertise across borders.

• Work in an office in collaborate with 100+ highly skilled colleagues from the Major Structures unit. The office is located in Kgs. Lyngby, Denmark.

• Become part of the COWI community through clubs, events and professional networks.

• Enjoy a strong social culture with activities such as Friday bars, Summer Parties and Christmas lunches.

We are looking for a proactive People & Organization (P&O) Generalist to join our People Experience team. You will support employees and leaders with day-to-day HR, while helping us improve the processes and enable value adding HR.

You will be a part of a global team, where you will be the key responsible for a variety of tasks and services related to the employee lifecycle for our Danish organization. It is a varied role that requires ownership for details as well as being mindful of the broader picture. Ideally, you will combine hands-on HR operations with problem-solving and continuous improvement in an international environment.

Become Part Of a Collaborative People Experience Team

**You will join a collaborative team of 13 talented colleagues within our global People & Organization function. Working mainly with our Danish organization, you will partner closely with employees, leaders, Talent Acquisition, P&O Legal, Payroll, and colleagues across the business.

The role is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Greater Copenhagen, and reports to the Head of People Experience.

Your focus will be to make HR support clear, efficient, and compliant while contributing ideas that make our ways of working simpler and better.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will support the everyday moments that shape the employee experience - from joining Bavarian Nordic to changes during employment and eventually leaving the company.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Support onboarding (contract and systems), employment changes, leave administration, and offboarding

• 
Guide employees and leaders on HR policies, processes, benefits, and employment matters

• 
Maintain accurate, compliant employee data and transactions in our core HCM system, Workday

• 
Handle leave administration, such as parental leave

• 
Drive global mobility activities, including work permits and services from external mobility partners

• 
Collaborate with external HR providers in countries without a local HR presence

• 
Improve processes and contribute to P&O projects that strengthen the employee experience.

**What We Are Looking For

**You bring a solid foundation in HR operations and enjoy balancing detail-oriented administration with improvement work while building excellent relations to employees.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Holds a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field

• 
Has solid experience in HR operations and employee lifecycle services, typically two years or more, depending on the scope and depth of experience

• 
Ideally brings experience from a regulated or compliance-driven industry on the global scene

• 
Understands HR processes, basic principles of employment law (DK), and maintains a strong compliance mindset

• 
Is comfortable working with HR systems: Workday & Docusign experience is an advantage

• 
Communicates fluently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy bringing structure, take initiative, and look for continuous improvement. You are energetic and bring a warm, service-minded approach that helps you build strong relationships. At the same time, you confidently take ownership and stand your ground when needed. You take pride in keeping essential day-to-day administrative tasks running smoothly.

If you are excited about combining HR operations, employee support, compliance, and continuous improvement, then this could be the right opportunity for you.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, you will join a purpose-driven company where people make a difference every day. Our work helps protect lives through innovative vaccines. A strong employee experience is an important part of making that possible.

We offer a collaborative and international environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to creating great employee experiences across the organization.

Beyond this, we offer:

• 
Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and bonus opportunities

• 
A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• 
Access to fitness discounts, massage scheme, and an active staff club with social and sporting events

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to become our next P&O pioneer, please apply now through our designated application platform. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position

Please note that visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

**About The Position

**As a Powerplant Engineer within Sunclass Airlines, you will have a key role within our Technical Department and CAMO organization focusing on either our A321ceo/neo or A330neo fleets. You will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating all engineering activities related to the maintenance, repair, and airworthiness within Powerplant Engineering and be involved in many other areas of the Technical Department as needed.

**Amongst Others, Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Ensuring compliance with all continuous airworthiness requirements associated with EASA Part CAMO within Powerplant Engineering

• Providing Powerplant Engineering advice and support to all the key areas of the airline

• Providing engine shop visit oversight, liaising with the applicable MROs to ensure that the repair and overhaul of engines/APUs comply with regulatory and contractual requirements

• Overseeing fleet reliability, monitoring fleet technical performance, developing improvement plans as required and generating the bi-weekly Engine Health Report.

• Performing Powerplant defect analysis, including monitoring and investigation of repetitive defects

• Assessing and managing technical publications including Service Bulletins, Regulatory Authority information and Airworthiness Directives to maintain and improve the fleet

• Liaising with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and vendors on all associated engineering and contractual / spares provisioning issues

• Involvement in the negotiation of relevant contracts and the subsequent ownership of those contracts

• Out of hours technical support and necessary communication with OEMs to enable the aircraft's safe return to service. (AOG Support)

**Must Haves

****Who we are looking for

**

• Degree in relevant Engineering subject or equivalent industry experience

• Thorough understanding of airworthiness regulations (EASA) and demonstrated experience in compliance management

• Specific experience with either CFM56/LEAP (A321) or Trent 7000 (A330) engine types

• Experience in Supplier and Contract Management

**Preferred

**

• Experience with AMOS or similar Management Information Systems (MIS)

• Experience with aircraft maintenance programmes, reliability and engine condition monitoring

• Experience of successfully managing complex engineering projects relevant to your field of responsibility

• Experience of working to company procedures

• Computer & IT literate

As a person, we are looking for someone with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You have excellent problem-solving abilities and are able to make appropriate and timely decisions. It is also important in this role to be conscientious, efficient, self-motivated and result driven.

**We offer

**We offer an exciting and developing environment where you get the opportunity for an internal career. We have a high level of employee engagement, which is shown year after year in our internal employee survey. We love our job and welcome you on board our journey in the Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

Sunclass Airlines is part of the Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG), which consists of the tour operators Spies in Denmark, Ving and Globetrotter in Sweden, Ving in Norway, Tjäreborg in Finland and the hotel company Resorts & Hotels. Sunclass Airlines flies the majority of the travel group's guests to our charter destinations and has over 1.000.000 travelers per year.

Read more about us at sunclassairlines.dk.

No Relocation Assistance Offered

****Who We Are

****Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

****People Experience Partner Nordics

******Salary Range: 643500 - 715000 annually

******Who We Are

****Colgate-Palmolive Company is a caring, innovative growth company that is reimagining a healthier future for all people, their pets, and our planet. Focused on Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, and Pet Nutrition, we sell our products in more than 200 countries and territories under globally recognized brands. We are celebrated for our leadership in sustainability, community wellbeing, and our unwavering commitment to living our core values.

Global People professionals are consistently drawn to Colgate-Palmolive by the exceptional opportunities for career advancement and a strong alignment with our purpose-driven company Values: We are Caring, We are Inclusive, We are Courageous. Within our Global People function, we foster a culture of high trust and autonomy, ensuring you feel empowered to make impactful decisions and directly influence our broader strategic priorities while you build a fulfilling, long-term career.

As a member of the People Experience team, you will be the heartbeat of the employee journey, owning the local execution of Global People programs and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can perform at their best and reach their full potential. You will be the primary partner for employees and managers in the Nordic Countries translating HR policies into practical solutions and driving operational excellence across the region. This is a unique opportunity for you to gain broad exposure across diverse businesses while influencing the growth and development of our global workforce.

In this role, you will act as a key generalist partner to employees and managers—guiding talent development, supporting organizational initiatives, supporting Employee Relations cases, and managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding through career transitions. Simultaneously, you will take ownership of accurate, compliant, and timely monthly payroll operations across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland, managing relationships with external providers and maintaining rigorous compliance with local labor and tax laws.

****Key Responsibilities

• People Experience Generalist

• Managing the execution of critical global People (HR) programs, including performance management, talent planning, learning & development and compensation, in close partnership with People Business Partners and Center of Excellence teams.

• Ensuring high quality experience around the "moments that matter" within the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and key career transitions.

• Coaching and advising managers on employee relations, performance management, career development, and leadership capabilities to elevate team performance and engagement.

• Support in employee relations cases with sound judgment, ensuring alignment with local labor laws and GDPR.

• Driving continuous improvement by identifying and diagnosing operational bottlenecks, developing and managing the implementation of solutions, and leveraging AI and digital tools to optimize HR service delivery.

• Utilizing data analytics and organizational diagnostics to identify trends and translate insights into actionable solutions for the business..

• Providing on-the-ground-feedback and insights to People Business Partners, CoE, and CBS- ensuring the broader People function remains connected to what is happening across the organization.

• Payroll, Benefits & Administration

• End-to-End Nordic Payroll Preparation: Accurate and timely preparation, entry, and validation of monthly payroll inputs (e.g., variable pay, new hires, terminations, leaves, and tax changes) across all responsible countries

• Serving as the first point of contact for employee and manager inquiries regarding payslips, leave balances and benefits.

• Rigorous Output Validation: Thorough auditing and reconciliation of pre-payroll and final payrolls from the external payroll provider to ensure zero-defect processing.

• Provider Management: Strong day-to-day alignment with the external payroll provider, driving accountability and smooth communication flows. Validate payroll data to guarantee 100% accuracy and SOX compliance.

• Nordic Benefits Administration: Hands-on management of local benefits programs, such as health insurance, pensions etc. across the Nordics.

• Statutory Leave & Benefit Tracking: Expert handling and tracking of statutory leaves (parental, sick leave etc.), including claims for government reimbursements (e.g., Försäkringskassan, Udbetaling Danmark, NAV, Kela).

****Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree

• 4+ years of relevant, progressive human resources experience, combining HR Generalist responsibilities with hands-on payroll and benefits administration.

• Nordic Market Experience: Proven track record running and / or overseeing payroll and benefits administration across multiple Nordic countries

• Strong knowledge of Nordic labor laws, local tax structures, social security environments, and Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).

• Hands-on experience working with cloud-based HRIS-platforms and major Nordic payroll solutions.

• Demonstrated ownership in managing competing priorities, multiple stakeholders, and complex timelines in a fast-paced environment.

• Professional fluency in at least one Scandinavian language (Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian) and excellent verbal and written communication in English

jobs.occupation: Carbon flux and particle export along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland’s coastal ocean
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship within the Center for Ice-Free Arctic Research (CIFAR) and the Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University.

Rapid warming is increasing freshwater inputs to the Arctic Ocean from melting glaciers, ice sheets, and altered precipitation patterns. Additionally, sea ice cover is rapidly declining. These changes are transforming the structure and functioning of the Arctic coastal ocean. CIFAR aims to understand how the complex interplay between ice melt, terrestrial runoff, and changing ocean conditions affects Arctic coastal ecosystems and their functioning across spatial and temporal scales.

Fjord systems are a critical interface between the cryosphere, the terrestrial environment and the coastal ocean. They act as important sites of carbon transformation, burial and export, yet we still have a limited understanding of how ongoing freshening will influence these processes. Increasing terrestrial runoff delivers large quantities of particles, minerals and organic carbon to coastal waters, while simultaneously altering water-column structure, particle synamics, and marine primary production.

The overall aim of this PhD project will be to determine how carbon is transformed and transported along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland fjords, and how changes in freshwater inputs influence carbon fluxes and particle export in coastal waters.

The project will investigate interactions between terrestrial organic carbon, marine-produced carbon and mineral particles, with a particular focus on understanding which components of the carbon pool are retained, transformed or exported from the water column. Although much of the terrestrial carbon entering Greenland's coastal systems is transported in particulate form, freshwater runoff also supplies dissolved organic carbon that can be highly bioavailable and rapidly processed within coastal ecosystems. Understanding the fate of these different carbon pools is therefore essential for predicting how Greenland's coastal carbon cycle may respond to continued freshening.

The student will have the opportunity to combine field observations from Greenland with laboratory and analytical approaches to investigate the sources, composition, transformation and export of carbon and particles. The precise scientific focus will be developed together with the student and the wider CIFAR research team.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree and have demonstrated interest and background in biogeochemistry, for example through a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, research project, internship, or other relevant research experience.

• Skills in data analysis and programming, using R, Python, or other relevant programming languages and analytical tools.

• Ability and willingness to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

• Marine or aquatic biogeochemistry

• Particle dynamics, sedimentation or particle export

• Geochemical or stable-isotope approaches

• Processing and analysis of environmental or oceanographic datasets

• Fieldwork in marine, coastal or Arctic environments

We particularly encourage applications from candidates who are scientifically curious and interested in developing their own ideas within the broader aims of the project.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Our purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

• Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• Some exposure to automated testing

• Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Kickstart your Career with Deloitte’s Finance Consultancy Programme
jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you interested in working in an exciting and challenging consulting role, where you can deploy and develop your skills and competencies within the CFO domain of companies? Do you hold a business-related Master’s degree by the summer of 2027, and are you ready to embark on a life-long learning journey in a leading global consulting firm? If yes, then we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Who we are

Joining our Finance Consultancy Programme, you will get to collaborate with experienced consultants on a wide variety of assignments and development opportunities. At Deloitte, we work with different project sizes across finance disciplines and industries, but the foundation is always the same: Our genuine passion for the CFO area and creating value together with our clients.

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte Technology & Transformation (former Consulting) consisting of more than 350 consultants in Denmark who work across all areas of the CFO function. We engage with clients to operate, advise, optimize, and transform their finance functions. Our clients range from domestic to international, from private to public, across various industries, sizes, and time horizons.

You will join a team that emphasizes collaboration, collegiality, coaching, and talent development. At Deloitte, we value diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, encouraging an inclusive and collaborative environment.

Job Description

Exciting tasks await you

As an Analyst in Deloitte Finance Transformation, you will experience that no workdays are the same. You will face a wide range of tasks, both in the form of interim-based roles and project-based assignments. Projects and tasks will vary across finance disciplines (e.g., operational finance or business finance) and industries (e.g., private or public), and within the first years of your career, you will be assigned to as many different projects and tasks as possible to expand your toolbox and build on your financial craftmanship.

Based on the specific client's needs and your interests, experiences, and competencies, typical assignments and projects could be within the scope of:

• Finance operations optimization and transformation, e.g., controlling, month-end closing, and reporting

• Transformation and digitalization of finance functions, e.g., process optimization, closing excellence, internal controls advisory, and leveraging technology solutions

• Enterprise performance management, e.g., analytics, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting

• ERP-enabled finance transformations and finance systems implementation, e.g., outlining the ERP-strategy, defining business requirements and ensuring consistent data migration

• Finance strategy and operating model, e.g., designing service delivery models, outlining roles and responsibilities and conducting assessments

• M&A readiness and finance post-merger integration

• Global business services transformations, e.g., assessing, developing and implementing shared service functions and aligning service delivery with corporate strategy

• Internal business development and leadership support, e.g., assisting on client proposals, facilitating events and developing material to strengthen our market offerings.

Onboarding and learning

When joining us, you will participate in our onboarding programme designed with the purpose of giving you the best foundation for kickstarting your career in Deloitte. During your first two weeks, you and your peers will attend our Finance Transformation Nordic Bootcamp and our Consultant Academy, where the content is tailored to match your competencies as recent graduates. The Finance Transformation Bootcamp helps you in building your finance craftmanship and toolbox, while the Consultant Academy prepares you for your consulting role in Deloitte Technology & Transformation. Also heavily focused on social activities and team-building, the onboarding programme provides a smooth transition from university as it offers a unique opportunity to connect and build strong relations with your fellow new joiners from day one.

At Deloitte, we believe in life-long learning, and we are committed to investing in your individual development, both professionally and personally, throughout your career. You will experience this with our Finance Consultancy Programme, which is a highly structured learning programme, aimed at equipping you with the appropriate skillset and the right level of competencies needed to succeed in your role.

Leadership and culture

To support your learning, you will also be assigned a People Leader as your closest leader and go-to sparring partner. Your People Leader will help you set the overall direction of your journey in Deloitte and provide guidance across projects to make sure that your individual aspirations and professional development goals are met. Every career path is unique, and together with your People Leader you get the chance to shape your own.

We believe in leadership at all levels, and we have committed ourselves to creating and maintaining an inclusive and psychologically safe culture, where you are encouraged and empowered to take responsibility while leading both yourself and others. We combine this with a substantial focus on continuously staying relevant and being a meaningful social community to our people. We are a people’s business, and therefore we strongly believe that this is an essential prerequisite for making an impact that truly matters – for ourselves and for our clients**.

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you, who are passionate about consulting and the CFO-area and who are willing to go the extra mile to deliver sustainable impact that truly matters to our clients. You show an eagerness to make a difference for both clients and colleagues and you are able to see the opportunities and potential in all types of assignments. As our business can be highly changeable, it is important that you are curious by nature, and that you face challenges with an open-minded and solution-oriented approach.

In addition to this, you:

• Have completed a master’s degree within the fields of finance, economics, business, accounting, social sciences, IT, or similar areas in the summer of 2027 or before

• Have achieved academic results from your bachelor’s and master’s degree that you are proud of

• Demonstrate a flair for both oral and written communication and are fluent in English

• Have a legal working permit in Denmark

Although relevant job experience might be an advantage, this is not a requirement.

Additional Information

Want to know more?

Click the "I'm interested"-button above and upload your CV and grade transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degree if you are interested and ready to join our team**. Instead of an application letter, we would like you to answer the questions you will be presented with on the next pages** (please only consider the required (*) fields). As we process applications and arrange interviews on an ongoing basis, we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Application deadline: Hiring on an ongoing basis.

Please do not hesitate to contact Giulio Marano (gimarano@deloitte.dk / +45 30 93 64 11) or Maria Banke (mbanke@deloitte.dk / +45 20 97 64 15) if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Company Description

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for the next step in your career? At Deloitte Engineering, we are looking for recent graduates and early-career software developers who want to strengthen their technical and problem-solving capabilities while helping us grow our Engineering practice. You will have the opportunity to work hands-on with software development while applying your skills in a consulting environment, working with clients to solve complex business and technology challenges.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Technology & Transformation.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, architects, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software developer. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a software developer at the Engineering offering, you will work with many different aspects of development, from writing code to testing it. You will work closely with both clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet their business needs and technical requirements. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development.

• Assisting in the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and adopting DevOps practices to streamline development workflows.

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You hold a Master’s degree, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Development, or another relevant technical field. You are either a recent graduate or have up to 4 years of full-time professional experience, preferably within software development. Experience from student positions, internships, or part-time software development roles is also considered an advantage. You enjoy applying your analytical and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and are motivated by working both hands-on with software and in a client-facing consulting environment. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

• Experience in Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, or one or more other widely used programming languages.

• Some experience with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and test automation.

• Some experience with modern system design and software architecture principles.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

• You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.

• You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

• Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.

• Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.

• The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027.

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

Disclosure on the Use of AI: We want to ensure that all applicants receive fair treatment in our recruitment process. This role is part of a pilot where we are testing an innovative approach to recruitment using AI, and therefore you should not upload a traditional cover letter. We want to be completely transparent about the pilot – Read more here.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Turn insights into acquisition experiments that scale

**About Good Tape

**At Good Tape, we’re building tools that make working with voice and audio effortless. We help journalists, researchers, and organisations capture, transcribe, and analyse conversations at scale. Our team is small, ambitious, and deeply technical, and we care about reliability and craft.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own Good Tape's acquisition engine: performance marketing, SEO, creative and to fuel our sales motion with a steady flow of qualified demand. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with the broader commercial team: Sales, Data, Product Marketing and Customer Success. Your job is to make sure the right people see (and click on) us in the first place, and keep coming back.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product to market.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Own performance marketing across paid channels, from strategy to execution.

• Drive SEO and organic acquisition, including content and site structure.

• Develop creative strategy and messaging for campaigns and launches.

• Own lifecycle and CRM: nurture flows, retention, and reactivation.

• Own top-of-funnel website content and landing pages; the pages that bring people in.

• Fuel SLG by partnering closely with Sales on positioning, demand gen, and maximizing MQL-to-SQL conversion.

• Feed acquisition learnings into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• Design skills (e.g. static/video ad creative) are a great plus, not a hard requirement

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in data-driven marketing, growth experimentation, and core SaaS metrics.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our brand, acquisition funnels, and demand gen engine.

• Help define how Good Tape reaches the people who need it.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into pipeline and growth.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.
